pages.observed: Contact sheet of five vertical frames 0.0 to 0.8 s. An airport curb scene with a canopy, phone map card reading Ride requested, airport sign, bench, teal suitcase, skyline and trees. A white car sits at the left edge with its front only partly visible. Scene barely changes across frames. A dark caption box with the text Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver, appears in the last two frames. The lower third of the frame is empty dark asphalt.

Five frames from 1.0 to 1.8 s. The white car enters from the left and travels right across the curb lane toward the painted pickup box, red brake light visible, wheels in place. Background, phone card and sign do not change. Caption box shows the same first line throughout. Lower third remains empty dark asphalt.

Frames 2.0 to 2.8 s. The white car stops by the pickup box, a cream Texas outline card appears at top right, then the view changes to a car interior from the back seat: dark empty steering wheel, small map screen on dash, mirror, windshield showing the airport sign. The phone card remains overlaid on the left and the disclaimer label at top. Caption unchanged. Lower area shows grey seat backs.

Frames 3.0 to 3.8 s inside the car cabin. The steering wheel visibly rotates by itself with no hands, the sign drifts out of the windshield to the right as the car moves, the dash route line grows, and the Texas card outline draws in progressively. Phone card and disclaimer are fixed overlays. Caption unchanged. Bottom third is grey seat backs.

Frames 4.0 to 4.8 s. Four cabin frames with the same overlays and caption, then the last frame cuts to the exterior airport curb with the phone card tilted and enlarged over the left, the white car partly hidden behind it, the Texas card showing a tiny orange dot, and a striped road area. The caption is gone in the last frame. Lower portion of last frame is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 5.0 to 5.8 s. Exterior curb scene with an enlarged tilted phone card overlapping the left half of the white car. The phone status changes from Ride requested to Arriving At the curb and its map position marker moves to meet the pin. Texas card dot becomes ringed. Caption reads the airport included. The lower third is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 6.0 to 6.8 s. The curb scene stays the same with the phone showing Arriving and the position marker reaching its pin. Caption shows only in the first frame. The last frame cuts to a new scene: a brown wooden table in perspective holding a cream grid map with three small pin marks and a February flip calendar, grass and trees behind. Texas card and disclaimer label remain at top. Lower part dark table planks.

Frames 7.0 to 7.8 s. A top-down-ish wooden table with a cream grid map and a February calendar. Initially only pin marks and a hatched patch, then blue river strokes and tan road strokes appear on the map at 7.6 and 7.8 s. Caption The service began in February. The Texas card becomes lighter in the last frame. Bottom third is table planks, mostly empty.

Frames 8.0 to 8.8 s. The same table scene. The map gains a long blue river winding down the centre, a second thinner river, a tan oval loop road and crossing roads, drawn progressively. The Texas card fades and is gone from 8.2 s onward. Caption The service began in February. The bottom third is empty table planks.

Frames 9.0 to 9.8 s. Camera moves closer to the table map. A note card reading 60 square miles Limited area with a red pin appears at the top of the map, a black leader line extends from it across the map, and the February calendar slips out right and returns near the lower left of the map. Caption changes to in a limited area of sixty square miles. Lower part is empty table planks.

Frames 10.0 to 10.8 s. A black line extends from the 60 square miles card and traces around the map's pins in a loop, closing at 10.8 s into a grey shaded polygon covering the central area with the river through it. The February calendar sits at lower left of the map. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. Bottom third is empty table planks.

Frames 11.0 to 11.8 s are essentially identical: the closed grey service-area polygon on the map, the note card, the February calendar at lower left, caption unchanged. Only tiny changes in pin position. Bottom third is empty table planks.

Frames 12.0 to 12.8 s. First two frames are the table map with the shaded polygon. From 12.4 s the film cuts to a top-down view of a white car lying in brown flowing water with pale streaks, green banks, and two round dark green bushes, foam at the car's right end. The disclaimer label now reads Illustration. A different car, April 20th account. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek appears at the last frame. Lower area is green bank and bushes.

Frames 13.0 to 13.8 s. Same overhead creek view with the white car resting in the brown water at left-center, foam on its right, pale ripples across the water, green bank with two round bushes. Very little motion. Caption In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek. in every frame. Lower part is green bank.

Frames 14.0 to 14.8 s. The overhead creek shot with the white car; it moves left and tilts slightly through 14.6 s, then at 14.8 s the view shifts so the car sits at lower right with a pale bank notch and bushes appearing above. Caption stays the same sentence. Foam clustered at the car's front end. Bottom area is green bank and bushes.

Frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. The white car tilts diagonally in the creek and moves left and rotates, foam piled at its front, wake streaks trailing, until it is partly out of frame at left. Water has pale ripple lines, banks have round bushes. Caption unchanged. Lower area is green bank.

Frames 16.0 to 16.8 s. The white car with foam moves off the left edge of the frame and is gone by 16.6 s, leaving an empty brown creek with pale ripple lines between green banks with bushes. Caption shows in the first three frames only. Lower area is green bank.

Frames 17.0 to 17.8 s. First two frames show the empty creek from above. From 17.4 s the film cuts to a side view of a neighborhood street under brown floodwater with a white car in it, its reflection below, beige houses, a leafy tree and green street signs behind, a dark shape at right edge, and paved ground in the foreground. Label reads Illustration. Another car, earlier in April. Caption Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater. Lower third is empty pavement.

Frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. The side view of the flooded street. The white car's wheels and lower body gradually go under the brown water so that by the last frame only the upper body shows with reflection. Background houses, tree and signs are static. Caption unchanged. The bottom third is empty pavement.

Frames 19.0 to 19.8 s. The partly submerged white car continues in the flooded street, orange hazard lights flicker on at the front and rear in two frames, and in the final frame the view moves in so the car is much larger with a blurred background of houses and a tree. Caption unchanged. Bottom third is empty pavement.

Frames 20.0 to 20.8 s. A closer view of the stranded white car sitting in brown water with its reflection, background houses and tree blurred. Hazard lights flicker orange and red from frame to frame and the car shifts slightly. Caption unchanged. Bottom third is empty pavement.

Frames 21.0 to 21.8 s. The same close view of the stranded white car in brown water with blinking hazard lights and reflection, blurred background. The caption shows in the first two frames and is gone from 21.4 s. No other change. Bottom third is empty pavement.

Frames 22.0 to 22.8 s. First frame is the flooded street. Then a cut to a flat olive background with a brown wooden desk band holding a tilted cream card titled Federal recall record, subtitle Vehicle safety recall, two blank rules, and a pen at the right edge cropped by the frame. Caption Waymo filed a software recall appears in the last two frames, a text cursor blinks on the card. Large empty olive areas above and below the desk.

Frames 23.0 to 23.8 s. The recall card straightens and sits at left of the desk, with its fields filling in: first Recall type Software, then by 23.6 s Potential units affected 3,791. A cursor flickers beside the fields. Pen at the right edge. Caption Waymo filed a software recall throughout. Large empty olive areas above and below the desk band.

Frames 24.0 to 24.8 s. Four frames of the static recall card with Software and 3,791 and caption Waymo filed a software recall. In the last frame the view shifts to the desk filling the frame, the card sits higher, and under it a 10-column grid of dashed car-slot outlines begins to fill with small white car icons, two complete and a third forming. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. A small wood block appears at the right edge.

Frames 25.0 to 25.8 s. A 10 by 5 grid of small white car icons fills in progressively under the recall card until all rows are complete. At the same time a forearm in a blue sleeve and a hand grips a wooden block, entering from the right edge and sliding left across the card at its rule line. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Bottom third is empty olive.

Frames 26.0 to 26.8 s. The hand with a wooden stamp presses onto the recall card, a cream note card reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles with 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in below the card, then an orange outlined Software recall stamp mark prints on the card and the hand moves off right. The 10 by 5 car grid stays full. Caption unchanged. Bottom third is empty olive.

Frames 27.0 to 27.8 s. The hand and stamp block exit to the right. The finished recall card with an orange Software recall stamp, the Nearly 3,800 vehicles note and the 10 by 5 car grid stay static. Caption is visible for the first three frames then removed. Lower third is empty olive.

Frames 28.0 to 28.8 s. First frame is the stamped recall card on the desk. Next frames show a road scene with a white car with roof sensor driving in from the left, lamp post, trees, small skyline and grass. Disclaimer reads Illustration. The recall wording, not a recorded event. A cream quote card labeled Federal recall record fades in reading The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, appears. Lower area is empty grass.

Frames 29.0 to 29.8 s. The white car stays at left of the road with wavy marks beneath its wheels while the dashed lane line and background move past slowly. The quote card from the Federal recall record stays solid at upper left, caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, unchanged. Lower half is empty olive grass.

Frames 30.0 to 30.8 s. The white car at left-center now shows red brake lights, and a long grey puddle of standing water slides in from the right edge along the lane. Background trees and skyline scroll slowly. Quote card unchanged, caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, unchanged. Lower half is empty olive grass.

Frames 31.0 to 31.8 s. The car sits left-center as a puddle slides toward it, then the shot jumps closer to a large side view of the white car with two faint passenger silhouettes in the windows and white wavy water lines under the wheels, puddle edge appearing at right in the last frame. Quote card persists. Caption changes to then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. Lower area is empty grass.

Frames 32.0 to 32.8 s. A close side view of the white car, wake lines under the wheels, and a grey standing-water puddle edge advancing from the right toward the car's nose. In the last frame the word may in the quote card is highlighted yellow. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. Bottom third is empty grass.

Frames 33.0 to 33.8 s. The word may in the quote card is highlighted in orange. A grey puddle slides leftward from the right and the car's front wheel sinks into it with small splash lines and ripples by 33.8 s. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. Bottom third is empty grass.

Frames 34.0 to 34.8 s. The car is in the puddle with its front wheel splashing, light wake lines and a reflection beneath. The background tree grows into the top right and a pole appears at 34.8 s. The quote card with the highlighted may and the caption are unchanged. Bottom third is empty grass.

Frames 35.0 to 35.8 s. First three frames show the car splashing through the puddle with the highlighted quote card above. At 35.6 s the film cuts to the desk scene: a large cream recall card with an orange Software recall stamp, Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791, and a big blank lower area. Disclaimer returns to Generic car with no brand mark. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. appears in the last frame. Bottom area olive empty.

Frames 36.0 to 36.8 s. On the recall card a peach Remedy panel with a dark left bar forms and its text types in as The remedy is currently under development. From 36.6 s a hand holding a pen enters from the right toward the card. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. throughout. The lower third of the frame is empty olive.

Frames 37.0 to 37.8 s. A hand with a pen points at the text The remedy is currently under development. on the recall card and pokes slightly. In the last frame the card grows a little and a second forearm in a blue sleeve holding a wooden stamp enters at the bottom of the card. Caption unchanged. Lower third empty olive.

Frames 38.0 to 38.8 s. Two forearms over the recall card, one holding a pen at the Remedy text and a larger one pressing a wooden stamp block that moves across the lower Remedy area. In the last frame a partly visible orange stamp mark beginning Und appears beneath the block. Caption unchanged. Lower third empty olive.

Frames 39.0 to 39.8 s. An orange Under development stamp mark is now on the Remedy panel. The stamp-holding arm and the pen arm slide off to the right and are mostly gone in the last frame. Caption shows in the first two frames only, then absent. The recall card with Software recall stamp stays. Lower third is empty olive.

Frames 40.0 to 40.8 s. A new scene: four white sensor-roofed cars parked in a diagonal row on wet dark asphalt with reflections, a fence and trees behind, wires overhead, a small Vehicle maps card and an April calendar page at upper right. From 40.4 s a note card Weather limits tightened with a red pin slides in from the left. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, appears. Lower area is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 41.0 to 41.8 s. The parked row of four cars stays still. The note card Weather limits tightened with a cloud and rain icon, hanging by a red pin from the overhead wire, slides slowly right across the frame, getting near the Vehicle maps card. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, unchanged. Lower area empty dark asphalt.

Frames 42.0 to 42.8 s. The scene is nearly static. The Weather limits tightened card hangs from the wire and rocks slightly, tilting differently in each frame. Cars are parked in the same row with reflections, caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, unchanged. Lower area is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 43.0 to 43.8 s. First three frames repeat the parked row with the hanging Weather limits card. At 43.6 s the view changes to a close, lower angle: the lead white car is large at left with passenger silhouettes in the windows, the other cars shrink in a line to the right, trees and a skyline behind, the wire card bigger at the top left. Caption becomes and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower area is wet asphalt with reflections.

Frames 44.0 to 44.8 s. A circle above the lead car fills with a large check mark at 44.2 s, then smaller circles above successive cars in the row fill with check marks in turn, with the farthest ones still forming in the last frame. The wire card, Vehicle maps card and April calendar stay. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower area is wet asphalt with a reflection.

Frames 45.0 to 45.8 s. All four car badges show check marks. The small Vehicle maps card's circle fills with a check and its label gains the word updated from 45.2 s. Everything else static. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. Lower area is wet asphalt with a large reflection.

Frames 46.0 to 46.8 s. The calendar at right flips from a blank April page to a page showing 20 at 46.4 s, and the old page lifts upward off the pad in later frames. Cars with check badges, the wire cards and the caption stay unchanged. Lower area is wet asphalt with a reflection.

Frames 47.0 to 47.8 s. The row of checked cars with the 20 calendar stays, caption only in the first frame. In the last frame a new scene appears: the airport pickup curb with canopy, a tall phone card reading Arriving At the curb, an airport sign, bench, suitcase, skyline and a white car in the pickup box. The label now reads Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. Lower half is empty asphalt.

Frames 48.0 to 48.8 s. The airport curb scene with the white car parked at the pickup box. In the last two frames the car's side door opens, showing a dark interior. The phone marker settles on its pin. Caption So the airport ride is open, appears. Lower third is empty asphalt.

Frames 49.0 to 49.8 s. The airport curb scene is nearly static with the white car at the pickup box and its rear door open showing a tan and dark interior. No passenger is shown. Caption So the airport ride is open, appears for four frames and is absent in the last. Lower third is empty asphalt.

Frames 50.0 to 50.8 s. A tighter view of the airport curb: the white car with open rear door in the pickup box, a sign, bench with a phone on it and a suitcase behind, the canopy columns. A small cream Federal recall record card, with the Remedy panel and Under development stamp, lies on the road in front of the car. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy. The lower half is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 51.0 to 51.8 s. The recall card with its peach Remedy panel and Under development stamp scales up and slides left and up over the road in front of the parked white car with the open rear door. Background curb elements are fixed. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy unchanged. Lower half is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 52.0 to 52.8 s. The same curb scene with the recall card in front of the open-door white car, barely moving. Caption stays and the federal record lists the flood remedy until the last frame where it changes to as currently under development. Lower half is empty dark asphalt.

Frames 53.0 to 53.8 s. The view now stacks the airport curb with the white car, open rear door, sign, bench and suitcase in the upper part over a wooden desk in the lower part, where the recall card sits beside a small phone card reading Arriving At the curb. A dark underline draws in under the words under development in the Remedy panel. Caption as currently under development. Lower third is empty desk wood.

Frames 54.0 to 54.8 s. The split view stays static: the airport curb with the white car and open door above, the desk with the recall card and the phone card below. The underline under under development stays. Caption as currently under development. is visible only in the first frame. Lower third is empty desk wood.

Frames 55.0 to 55.8 s. The split composition with the airport curb above and the desk with the recall card and phone card below does not change. No caption shown in any frame. The car door stays open and no passenger or movement is shown. The lower 40 percent of the frame is empty desk wood.

Frames 56.0 to 56.8 s. Black end card with a small orange label THE DAILY DISPATCH, a Texas flag icon, the wordmark Texas AI Docket, an orange rule, a Visit the Docket row with texasaidocket.com and an arrow, then small credit blocks for sources, illustration, map and music. The flag and wordmark start dim grey and brighten to full by 56.2 s. No caption. Lower 40 percent is empty black.

Frames 57.0 to 57.8 s. The identical static end card in every frame: orange label, Texas flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, orange rule, texasaidocket.com row with arrow, and the source, illustration, map and music credits in small type. No motion and no caption. The lower 40 percent of the frame is empty black.

Frames 58.0 to 58.8 s. The same static end card, identical in all five frames: orange label, flag, wordmark, rule, link row and credits. No motion, no caption. Lower 40 percent of the frame empty black.
Frames 59.0 to 59.8 s. The same static end card in all five frames, unchanged, with flag, wordmark, link row and credits. No motion and no caption. Lower 40 percent of the frame empty black.
Frames 60.0 to 60.8 s. The same static end card in all five frames with orange label, Texas flag, wordmark, link row and credit blocks. No motion and no caption. Lower 40 percent empty black.

Single final frame at 60.967 s, frame 1829. The same static end card as the preceding seconds: orange label, Texas flag, wordmark, rule, texasaidocket.com row and credits. No caption. Lower 40 percent of the frame is empty black.
